description: We’re a 3 person team of students from the University of California, Merced. Our skills include Python, data analysis, full stack devlopment, and design. We’re tackling challenges involving Earth observation, astronomy, data visualization, and we’ve got our crew set to the challenge. We’re excited to see what everyone builds and share ideas along the way!
summary: We built a public web tool that lets anyone explore the SPHEREx sky images and be able to spot the objects that move and change overtime. Users enter coordinates of a patch of sky (in RA and Dec), then our tool displays the images of the patch as a time series they can pan and zoom through. Which highlights the wavelength and obersvation date for each image. We've tested the tool on WISE 0855, Barnards's Star, and comet 3I/ATLAS.
